user.title: User
user.description: Opaque identifier for the end user supplied by the calling platform.

images.title: Images
images.description: Optional reference image(s) the prompt edits or draws from; each is an http(s) URL or base64, one to 10 total.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Under `auto` a ratio the prompt asks for wins, otherwise the output keeps the first reference image's framing; without references the prompt decides, else 1:1.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Image resolution class, an equal-pixel-area tier: `768sq`, `1k` (default), `1.5k`, `2k`, or `4k`. Exact dimensions vary with the aspect ratio. `match_input` (edits only): the output keeps the first reference's own size (shrunk to 4 MP when larger), or its nearest tier when aspect_ratio is set. Ignored when width and height are set.

width.title: Width
width.description: Exact output width in pixels, [256, 6256]; set together with height. Overrides resolution and aspect_ratio.

height.title: Height
height.description: Exact output height in pixels, [256, 6256]; width x height at most 16822272 pixels, and at most 4194304 with reference images.

safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
safety_tolerance.description: Harm moderation tolerance from 0 to 7, with 0 the strictest. The route and organization determine the approved maximum and per-category ceilings. Unapproved levels return 422 with approved levels.

grounding.title: Grounding
grounding.description: When true (default) the prompt may be grounded in external research: web search and image search. When false, both are off.

version.title: Version
version.description: Endpoint version. `latest` (default) serves the current release; dated pinnable release tags are added here as they are published.
